item.title: Plaza financiera argentina abordada por selectividad y seguimiento externo
item.description: El mercado financiero argentino arrojaba este viernes una nueva ronda de marcada selectividad, mientras que el riesgo país se mantenía por arriba de los 600 puntos básicos.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El mercado financiero argentino arrojaba este viernes una nueva ronda de marcada selectividad, mientras que el riesgo país se mantenía por arriba de los 600 puntos básicos. Las miradas de los inversores posaban también en el impacto del dato de empleo en Estados Unidos y las implicancias políticas regionales con elecciones presidenciales del domingo en el vecino Brasil. En la bolsa de Buenos Aires, el referencial accionario S&P Merval (.MERV) arrojaba una ligera mejora del 0,11% a las 1445 GMT, al tiempo que los bonos soberanos extrabursátiles promediaban un marcha neutra. "El mercado en Estados Unidos reaccionó positivamente a datos peores que los esperados de tasa de desempleo y nóminas de empleados (...) La tasa de desempleo subió a 4,2%, frente al 4,1% esperado. Un mercado laboral más débil le quita fuerza a la expectativa de suba de tasas en la próxima reunión de la FED en octubre", remarcó Quantum Finanzas. Mientras tanto, el riesgo país argentino se movía en niveles de los 636 puntos básicos, muy lejos de las ansiadas 250 a 300 unidades como para que eventualmente el Gobierno pensara en retornar a los mercados internacionales de crédito ante un pesado panorama de vencimientos en el 2027. "Para la Argentina, el resultado electoral de Brasil no es neutro en el plano político: un nuevo mandato de Lula (da Silva)prolongaría la distancia con la Casa Rosada, mientras que un triunfo de (Flavio) Bolsonaro abriría una etapa de mayor afinidad con el Gobierno de (Javier) Milei", reportó la consultora ABECEB. "Sin embargo, el comercio bilateral se mantiene firme pese al enfriamiento diplomático, porque responde a una lógica productiva, con el intercambio automotriz como columna vertebral, que los vaivenes de la política no alcanzan a alterar", agregó. El peso mayorista ganaba apenas un 0,1% a 1.523,5 por dólar , con regulación del banco central (BCRA) mediante la compra diaria de divisas para reforzar sus reservas internacionales.

item.title: Halliburton no participará en proyecto petrolero en las Malvinas
item.description: Halliburton anunció el viernes que comunicó a las autoridades argentinas que no trabajará en el proyecto petrolero marítimo Sea Lion ni participará en actividades de exploración y producción de hidrocarburos en las islas Malvinas, ni en sus alrededores.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Halliburton (HAL.N) anunció el viernes que comunicó a las autoridades argentinas que no trabajará en el proyecto petrolero marítimo Sea Lion ni participará en actividades de exploración y producción de hidrocarburos en las islas Malvinas, ni en sus alrededores. El proveedor de servicios petroleros añadió que las autoridades federales argentinas plantearon dudas sobre la posible participación de la empresa en el proyecto y sobre la aplicación de la legislación vigente y propuesta en relación con las actividades en el territorio británico en disputa. La declaración se conoce despues de que el presidente argentino, Javier Milei, intensificó la reivindicación del país sobre las islas Malvinas con sanciones para las empresas implicadas en la explotación petrolera del territorio británico de ultramar. En septiembre, Milei presentó un proyecto de ley para tomar medidas drásticas contra las empresas que operan en las Islas Malvinas, lo que podría agravar la tensión con el Reino Unido por el territorio controlado por Gran Bretaña pero reclamado por Argentina. Se estima que el yacimiento petrolero Sea Lion, situado a unas 225 kilometros al norte de las Islas Malvinas, alberga 1.700 millones de barriles de petróleo. Argentina se ha opuesto al proyecto desde su descubrimiento en 2010, cuando declaró ilegal la perforación en el yacimiento.

item.title: Ｇ７、石油備蓄1億バレルを協調放出へ 軽油を前倒し
item.description: [パリ ２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[パリ ２日 ロイター] - 主要７カ国（Ｇ７）は２日の首脳共同声明で、世界のエネルギー市場の安定化に向け、国際エネルギー機関（ＩＥＡ）を通じて軽油などの備蓄１億バレルを協調放出すると発表した。直ちに開始し、４カ月間にわたって実施する。

フランス大統領府が公表した声明によると、Ｇ７加盟国とパートナー国は最初の２０日間に大量の軽油を前倒しで放出する。マクロン仏大統領は、放出対象が軽油と原油で、規模は最大１億バレルになると説明した。

Ｇ７はまた、加盟各国の製油所の保守点検日程を調整する方針を表明。ＩＥＡに対し、２０２６年３月の約束が直ちに、かつ完全に履行されるよう監視することを要請した。

エネルギーおよびエネルギー製品について、Ｇ７諸国間で輸出制限を控えるとの約束を再確認。全ての生産国に対し、市場の緊張を悪化させかねない禁止措置を導入しないよう求めた。

マクロン氏は、ホルムズ海峡を通じた供給の確保に向け、引き続き行動を調整することで合意したと述べた。

声明はイランによる近隣諸国への攻撃を改めて非難し、ロシアに対する制裁を維持する方針も示した。

item.title: Chinese auto show debuts in Argentina as their sales surge
item.description: Buenos Aires is hosting its first Chinese auto show on Friday as Argentina’s car market under President Javier Milei has shifted from heavy protectionism to a more open and competitive environment.
item.dc:creator: Leila Miller
item.content:encoded: Buenos Aires is hosting its first Chinese auto show on Friday as Argentina’s car market under President Javier Milei has shifted from heavy protectionism to a more open and competitive environment. Chinese brands are flooding the market, benefiting from a measure that allows up to 50,000 electric and hybrid vehicles without tariffs in 2026. Chinese brands accounted for 10% of cars and light commercial vehicle sales in Argentina in August, up from about 2% late last year. Since launching in Argentina [USN:L6N3VO0YF TEXT:"in late 2025"], China's electric vehicle (EV) maker BYD (002594.SZ) , has become the ninth best-selling car brand. The company leads electric car sales in Brazil, Colombia, Ecuador and Uruguay. At the auto show, there will be more than 20 Chinese brands, including [USN:L4N45E0BT TEXT:"Geely 0175.HK "], Chery (9973.HK) ,GWM (601633.SS) and [USN:L1N45K00B TEXT:"Dongfeng"]. Sebastian Beato, president of Argentina’s auto dealers’ association ACARA, said the "impressive" growth among Chinese brands had pushed the national industry to produce new models, such as the [USN:L8N4500PL TEXT:"Renault Niagara"] pick-up truck unveiled in September. Earlier this week the Argentine government said Japanese automaker Toyota Motor (7203.T) would [USN:L6N45M1A7 TEXT:"invest"] $1.34 billion to develop an EV plant in Argentina. If Argentina's auto industry doesn’t transform, "it’s going to have obsolete cars,” Beato said. MILEI UNCONCERNED Chinese automakers are steadily expanding across Latin America, selling both traditional vehicles and EVs at a pace that has alarmed some local markets. Brazil and Mexico have introduced tariffs aimed at slowing the influx and protecting domestic manufacturing jobs. But Milei, a libertarian, has said he is unconcerned by the rapid growth of Chinese automaker BYD and dismissed suggestions that it could complicate his close relationship with the United States, China's geopolitical rival, during an interview last month. "What Argentines buy is the problem of Argentines," Milei told Bloomberg at the Economic Club of New York. Tesla in July launched operations in Uruguay, and there are signs the US automaker could soon enter Argentina. The registration of Tesla Argentina appeared in the country's official gazette in April, and state energy company YPF said in June it had signed a letter of intent with Tesla to explore [USN:S0N41Q00Y TEXT:"energy storage"] opportunities. Tesla did not respond to a request for comment. 'POSSIBILITY TO COMPETE' Car sales in Argentina have fallen 13% so far this year from the same period in 2025, a decline that industry analysts attribute to a market adjustment after last year's strong growth was fueled by lower trade barriers. High interest rates have also dissuaded consumers from taking out car loans. Andres Civetta, an economist at consultancy Abeceb, said Argentina's auto industry should focus on pick-up trucks, where the country has established a strong export position and doesn't yet face competition from Chinese brands. Fernando Rodriguez Canedo, executive director of Argentina's association of car factories, welcomed Milei's gradual rollback of national export duties and said the industry was also pressing provincial governments to reduce local taxes. "That would give us the possibility to compete," Canedo said.

item.title: Trump deve anunciar Jay Clayton como czar da IA
item.description: O presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, deve nomear o diretor de Inteligência Nacional dos EUA, Jay Clayton, como seu principal assessor em IA — cargo que o presidente já chamou de “czar da IA” no passado —, segundo uma fonte a par da decisão.
item.dc:creator: Alexandra Alper, Courtney Rozen, Erin Banco
item.content:encoded: O presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, deve nomear o diretor de Inteligência Nacional dos EUA, Jay Clayton, como seu principal assessor em IA — cargo que o presidente já chamou de “czar da IA” no passado —, segundo uma fonte a par da decisão. Clayton já supervisiona 18 agências de inteligência dos EUA como principal chefe de espionagem do país. “Qualquer anúncio sobre pessoal será feito diretamente pelo presidente”, afirmou uma autoridade da Casa Branca em comunicado à Reuters quando questionada sobre a escolha de Clayton para o cargo. “Qualquer notícia divulgada até lá é especulação infundada.” A notícia foi divulgada pela primeira vez pela CBS. No mês passado, Trump disse que planeja nomear um assessor de inteligência artificial, conhecido como “czar da IA”, e criar uma “força de IA”, embora não tenha dado detalhes sobre nenhuma das iniciativas nem sobre como elas seriam implementadas. A iniciativa de Trump ocorre no momento em que importantes pesquisadores da área de IA alertam que os desenvolvedores acreditam que a inteligência artificial poderia matar seres humanos dentro de uma década, após casos de agentes de IA que se tornaram rebeldes e invadiram sistemas externos. Vários parlamentares democratas e republicanos reagiram com preocupação e pediram mais medidas. Esta é a segunda vez que Trump nomeia um assessor para supervisionar decisões relacionadas à IA. O investidor de risco David Sacks ocupou o cargo de responsável pela área de IA no início do segundo mandato de Trump, antes de deixar a Casa Branca. Sacks continua aconselhando Trump sobre IA e participou, na terça-feira, de uma reunião com o presidente e executivos do setor.

item.title: Pasajes gratis de TransMilenio en octubre: quiénes los reciben y cómo activarlos en la tarjeta TuLlave
item.description: Más de 714.000 personas en Bogotá tienen asignados pasajes gratuitos este mes. El beneficio se entrega mediante la estrategia de Ingreso Mínimo Garantizado y debe activarse en una tarjeta TuLlave pers ...
item.dc:creator: Daniel Guerrero
item.content:encoded: Bogotá — Los pasajes gratis de TransMilenio correspondientes a octubre de 2026 ya están disponibles para su activación. La Secretaría Distrital de Integración Social (SDIS) informó que 714.000 personas fueron incluidas en este ciclo, con una inversión de COP$10.774 millones. El beneficio hace parte de la estrategia de Ingreso Mínimo Garantizado (IMG) y está dirigido a población en situación de pobreza, personas mayores, personas con discapacidad y otros grupos en condiciones de vulnerabilidad. La asignación se realiza de manera automática de acuerdo con los criterios de focalización establecidos por el Distrito. Para octubre, el Distrito reportó 332.000 personas mayores de 62 años, 160.000 personas con discapacidad y 220.000 personas en condición de pobreza entre los principales grupos beneficiarios. También están incluidas personas mayores vinculadas a la Comunidad del Cuidado, exhabitantes de calle vinculados al servicio de Hospedaje Social y personas que viven en viviendas tipo pagadiarios. En el caso de las personas en pobreza extrema o moderada, la cantidad de pasajes depende de su clasificación en el Sisbén IV. Para las personas con discapacidad pueden asignarse entre uno y 12 pasajes mensuales, mientras que las personas mayores de 62 años pueden recibir entre uno y ocho. La población en pobreza extrema y moderada puede recibir entre cinco y siete pasajes. Los grupos incorporados al esquema desde febrero de 2026 tienen asignaciones específicas. Quienes viven en pagadiarios pueden recibir siete pasajes si están en pobreza extrema y cinco si están en pobreza moderada; las personas mayores de la Comunidad del Cuidado reciben ocho, y los exhabitantes de calle vinculados al Hospedaje Social reciben 22 pasajes. El beneficio se entrega exclusivamente mediante una tarjeta TuLlave personalizada. TransMilenio señala que contar con esta tarjeta es un requisito para que puedan asignarse los pasajes gratuitos. Las personas que ya tienen una tarjeta personalizada no necesitan adquirir una nueva, salvo que esté bloqueada. Si aún no cuenta con una, debe realizar el proceso de personalización en un punto autorizado. La asignación no significa que los pasajes aparezcan automáticamente disponibles para usar. Una vez asignado el beneficio, el usuario debe realizar la activación en la tarjeta. El proceso puede hacerse en las taquillas de las estaciones y portales de TransMilenio o mediante los puntos automáticos del sistema. En taquilla: el usuario debe presentar su tarjeta TuLlave personalizada y solicitar al funcionario la activación de los pasajes gratuitos asignados. En un punto automático: debe insertar la tarjeta en el dispositivo y seleccionar, en este orden, “Transacciones virtuales” y luego “Solicitar Subsidio/Convenio”. Después debe confirmar los pasajes asignados y finalizar el proceso. La Secretaría Distrital de Integración Social aclara que la cantidad asignada depende de las condiciones socioeconómicas y de la pertenencia a alguno de los grupos poblacionales focalizados. Uno de los puntos que deben tener en cuenta los beneficiarios es que los pasajes asignados para octubre no son acumulables. Si no se activan o utilizan durante el periodo correspondiente, no se trasladan automáticamente al mes siguiente. Por eso, quienes hayan sido incluidos en el ciclo de octubre deben activar la recarga en su tarjeta personalizada y utilizar los viajes asignados dentro del periodo correspondiente. La asignación se realiza automáticamente a quienes cumplen los criterios establecidos por el programa. El Distrito indica que las personas que consideran que pertenecen a uno de los grupos priorizados, pero no encuentran el beneficio en su tarjeta, pueden solicitar orientación a la Secretaría Distrital de Integración Social. Para estos casos está habilitada la línea 601 380 8330, opción 6, correspondiente a Ingreso Mínimo Garantizado. También es posible acudir a las subdirecciones locales de Integración Social.

item.title: Pétrole Les pays du G7 vont libérer 100 millions de barils sous quatre mois-communiqué
item.description: Les dirigeants du G7 sont convenus vendredi de libérer leurs réserves stratégiques de produits pétroliers "jusqu'à 100 millions de barils, sous 4 mois" face à la crise énergétique mondiale, peut-on lire dans un communiqué.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Les dirigeants du G7 sont convenus vendredi de libérer leurs réserves stratégiques de produits pétroliers "jusqu'à 100 millions de barils, sous 4 mois" face à la crise énergétique mondiale, peut-on lire dans un communiqué. La France assure actuellement la présidence du G7 et le chef de l'Etat français, Emmanuel Macron, a présidé vendredi une visioconférence sur la situation énergétique mondiale avec ses homologues, en coordination avec l'Agence internationale de l'énergie (AIE). "Nous sommes d'accord pour travailler de manière coordonnée pour contribuer à la baisse des prix des produits pétroliers, notamment du diesel", précise le communiqué du G7, relayé par la présidence française. Trois décisions ont ainsi été prises : - "flexibiliser la production pour produire au maximum de nos capacités de nos raffineries. - libérer nos réserves stratégiques jusqu'à 100 millions de barils, sous 4 mois, avec nos partenaires, sous la coordination de l'Agence internationale de l'énergie. - ne prendre aucune mesure de restriction des échanges de produits énergétiques et pétroliers entre pays partenaires."

item.title: How Turkey's investment fund bubble burst
item.description: Turkey's investment fund sector faces a deepening crisis after regulators last month ordered the liquidation of 131 funds managed by seven asset managers following warnings by some that they could not meet redemption payments.
item.dc:creator: Mirac Dereli, Canan Sevgili
item.content:encoded: Turkey's investment fund sector faces a deepening crisis after regulators last month ordered the liquidation of 131 funds managed by seven asset managers following warnings by some that they could not meet redemption payments. The funds had reached more than [USN:L6N45L0PJ TEXT:"$20 billion in assets"] over just three years, as nearly half a million investors including politicians, former officials and celebrities sought bumper returns to offset a depreciating lira and high inflation. This expansion continued even after Turkish authorities alleged that some funds were being used for market manipulation. The crisis dragged stocks into a bear market, with the main index having its [USN:L6N45M19Q TEXT:"worst month since"] 2008 in September. The following sets out the crisis and what may come next. HOW THE FUND BOOM BEGAN Turkey has kept monetary policy tight to tame inflation and encourage lira-denominated savings, boosting interest in funds offering returns above inflation and local deposit rates. Some of the investment funds became concentrated in a single stock or asset, while others had only a handful of investors. Some of these funds traded recently listed small-cap shares, where lower liquidity allowed prices to move sharply, which in turn boosted the daily returns of the funds holding them. WARNING SIGNS Turkish officials [USN:L8N3WG0M3 TEXT:"warned about manipulation"] through investment funds in November 2025. "We know that these manipulations are being carried out particularly through certain funds," Finance Minister Mehmet Simsek said, adding that regulatory gaps would be addressed. Omer Gonul, then the chairman of Turkey's Capital Markets Board (SPK), said regulators were monitoring funds used to circumvent rules and warned that managers could face penalties including license cancellations. TWO FUNDS AT CENTRE OF CRISIS Two asset managers at the centre of the turmoil, Tera Portfoy and Pusula Portfoy, expanded rapidly before the crisis. Tera and Pusula have not responded to Reuters requests for comment. Turkey's portfolio management industry assets rose to $329 billion in August 2026 from $246 billion a year earlier, data from the Capital Markets Board shows. Tera's assets under management increased more than 10-fold to $14.3 billion over the same period, while Pusula's assets jumped 13-fold to $13.2 billion as more investors trickled in. By the end of August, Tera was sixth and Pusula eighth among Turkey's portfolio managers, each with a share of total managed assets exceeding 4%, making them the sector's biggest non-bank companies. CUMULATIVE RETURN OF 15,000% Some funds reported sharp rises in assets and investors. Tera's TLY hedge fund returned 747% in lira terms between January and July 2025, when it had fewer than 200 investors. After becoming available to a broader investor base in July, its cumulative return climbed to more than 15,000% in lira terms by September. TLY attracted 102,616 investors and grew to $5 billion in assets, making it the largest of the funds being liquidated. It was followed by Tera's TP2 money market fund, with $4.6 billion in assets and around 167,000 investors. TP2 provided a 123% return to investors over the same period, when the inflation rate was 60%. WHO HAS BEEN CAUGHT UP IN THE CRISIS? Regulators have widened their investigation into suspected market manipulation in stocks and fund markets. Justice Minister Akin Gurlek [USN:L8N45M11P TEXT:"said"] that the number of suspects had risen to 217, with 56 jailed pending trial. Fatma Betul Sayan Kaya, a deputy chair of President Tayyip Erdogan's ruling AKP, [USN:L8N45J00R TEXT:"resigned"] from her party posts after an opposition politician alleged that she and her husband had made substantial profits trading Ozata Denizcilik (OZATD.IS) shares ahead of the turmoil. The shares are part of a broader market manipulation investigation. Kaya said on X she considered it necessary to take political responsibility while the allegations were examined. She did not comment further. Those jailed include senior executives [USN:L6N45B05S TEXT:"linked to"] Tera and Pusula. Erkan Kilimci, a former central bank deputy governor who later became a Tera executive, was also jailed, broadcaster NTV said. Kilimci said in a LinkedIn post before he was jailed that it was "unlucky" to have his name caught up in the allegations due to the senior Tera post he occupied for three months. Kilimci's post did not directly comment on the allegations and Reuters was unable to reach his representatives for further comment. Kaya's adviser did not respond to a request for comment. WHAT HAPPENS NEXT? Istanbul's main index (.XU100) closed 2.5% higher on Thursday as [USN:L1N45E07V TEXT:"sweeping changes"] to its constituents took effect, removing stocks caught up in the crisis. The SPK said liquidating the funds will take six months and investors in certain funds with net investments below 1 million lira ($20,396) will get full repayment. Those with 1 million lira [USN:L6N45N0DI TEXT:"or more invested"] will receive an interim payment of 1 million lira. Turkey's Savings Deposit Insurance Fund has opened accounts for investors seeking to return what authorities describe as "excessive gains" from fund sales. JPMorgan [USN:L8N45O0G7 TEXT:"analysts said"] the fund sector turmoil brought "meaningful downside risks" to Turkey's 2026 GDP growth forecast of 3%. It remains unclear how much the total loss to investors will be. Attention is turning to the prices at which fund assets can be converted into cash as many funds hold thinly traded stocks, potentially complicating the process.

item.title: Blazers hire, fire announcer on same day after old posts surface
item.description: Just hours after the Portland Trail Blazers announced the hiring of play-by-play announcer Braiden Bell, they fired him.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Just hours after the Portland Trail Blazers announced the hiring of play-by-play announcer Braiden Bell, they fired him. On Thursday, he was named to replace longtime announcer Kevin Calabro but then dismissed after social media posts he made as a teenager were uncovered. The posts, on Twitter (now X), called women derogatory names and included an insult to Asians, although Bell referred to himself as "not racist" in the same post. The comments were posted in late 2012 and early 2013. "The Portland Trail Blazers have zero tolerance for racist, sexist, or harmful comments," the team said in a statement posted to social media later Thursday. "Social media posts made by our recently announced play-by-play broadcaster are in clear violation of team and league policies, as well as our values and expectations. Therefore, we will not be moving forward with this broadcaster." The Trail Blazers learned about the posts from a reporter for KGW in Portland who uncovered them and asked the club for comment. According to Bell's LinkedIn page, he studied journalism at Arizona State from 2015-19 and then became the voice of Cal Baptist sports in fall 2019. He left that post in mid-2024 and began calling games for Arizona State, the WNBA's Phoenix Mercury and the Valley Suns of the G League. Last fall, he also made his debut with FS1 on Big 12 football. Bell has not commented publicly since his dismissal, but earlier in the day, expressed his appreciation for the new job. "Rip City -- Wow, it's going to be an awesome ride!" he posted. "It's hard to describe the honor I'm feeling. I can't wait to settle into this community & fanbase. "My goal is to make you proud every game and honor the incredible history & tradition of Blazers play-by-play. Talk to you soon!" He since has made his X account private. The franchise's statement included an apology. "We did not meet our own bar in this process, and for that we apologize to Blazers fans and to Rip City," the Trail Blazers said. "We strongly believe that everyone who is a part of Rip City should feel welcome and safe and we will make sure that our new broadcaster reflects these values. We will do better." The team begins the new season Oct. 21 at home against the Phoenix Suns. --Field Level Media

item.title: Meta’s Muse is adorable agent of value destruction
item.description: The digital concierge may have a cute mascot, but its chart-topping release devoured $1 trln of market value once held by travel, financial and media firms. At least the panic might be brief: new agent rivals and sophisticated use of AI by affected businesses will be equalizers.
item.dc:creator: Robert Cyran
item.content:encoded: Cute raccoons decimated Japan's natural habitat after pets were let loose in the wild. The same dynamic is playing out with Muse, the AI agent released by Meta Platforms (META.O) in early September. The digital concierge's adorable, chubby mascot helped propel it to 5 million downloads, only to wreak havoc in markets. Services, financial, media, and other industries' valuations were punished on fears that an automated assistant would trash their business models. The panic might be short-lived. Over the past month, the headline S&P 500 Index (.SPX) , which represents over three quarters of US stock-market capitalization, was roughly unchanged. Constituent Meta, however, gained some $450 billion in value. Combined with gains for big chip firms Nvidia (NVDA.O) , Intel (INTC.O) and AMD (AMD.O) , the sum is over $1 trillion. Nearly everything else fell, implying other sectors shed a similar amount. Sure, higher interest rates and energy prices are also a cause. But investors fear Meta’s agent may decimate ecosystems dependent on subscriptions, middlemen, and consumer laziness. Travel companies seem obvious losers. Just as the internet replaced agencies with easy and cheaper self-service, Muse may displace them with cheap automation. Shares of Booking (BKNG.O) and Expedia (EXPE.O) lost close to a fifth of their value in a month. Worry over agents canceling user subscriptions hurt others. Close to a fifth of recurring payments are for unused services, according to a CNET survey. The pain rippled through companies like Netflix (NFLX.O) , Spotify Technology (SPOT.N) and Planet Fitness (PLNT.N) which lost 18%, 12% and 20%, respectively. Business services and intermediaries were also whacked. Tax forms can be farmed out to a bot instead of an accountant, sending H&R Block (HRB.N) and Intuit (INTU.O) down nearly 20%. Car vendors like AutoNation (AN.N) and CarMax (KMX.N) saw a similar fall on fears brainy digital assistants might gather relevant comparisons and bargain relentlessly for better deals. Finally, financial institutions also lost on the prospect of well-off customers handing the keys to AI helpers. Credit card debt might automatically transfer to zero-rate offers, and low-interest deposits could be sent to higher-yielding pastures. Capital One (COF.N) and Bank of America (BAC.N) lost more than 10%. The list of winners was smaller, with Meta heading it. Yet leading machine-learning products tend to quickly face improved or cheaper offerings from rivals. Renewed fears over hefty investment could easily vaporize the tech giant’s gains. Customers may benefit as automated assistants take over bill paying and discount negotiation. But businesses will use AI themselves, attempting to wring higher margins and wrong-foot consumers' bots. If the future is both sides relying on agents to extract value from each other, perhaps the only real beneficiaries will be chipmakers powering the arms race. Follow Robert Cyran on Bluesky . Muse, Meta Platforms’ new AI agent, exceeded 5 million downloads on September 30 according to market research firm Sensor Tower. Meta released Muse on September 8. In addition to a free, basic level of service, people can pay $20 or $100 per month for progressively heavier use. CONTEXT-NEWS

item.description: [ワシントン ２日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２日、韓国との通商合意に８４億ドル規模の石油増進回収（ＥＯＲ）プロジェクトが含まれると明らかにした。ただ、
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン　２日　ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２日、韓国との通商合意に８４億ドル規模の石油増進回収（ＥＯＲ）プロジェクトが含まれると明らかにした。ただ、 韓国の聨合ニュースは産業通商資源省高官の話として、同プロジェクトは両国間の戦略的投資協定の一環ではないと報じた。

トランプ大統領は自身の交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」に「韓国との合意は一段と改善している！石油増進回収プロジェクトに８４億ドルが投じられる。石油・ガスの増産は、米国のエネルギー覇権と将来に向けた世界のエネルギー安全保障につながる！」と投稿した。

聨合ニュースの報道によると、韓国政府の当局者は米国側に問い合わせを行ったという。

トランプ氏は９月３０日、韓国が米国内の事業に約２０００億ドルを投資すると発表。ただ、韓国政府はその後、計画の柱の一つとされたアラスカ州の液化天然ガス（ＬＮＧ）事業向け５４０億ドル規模のパイプライン建設について、現時点で確定したものではないとの認識を示していた。

item.title: Nasdaq atinge máxima recorde após dados de emprego nos EUA reduzirem apostas em alta de juros
item.description: As ações dos Estados Unidos subiam nesta sexta-feira, levando o Nasdaq a uma máxima recorde, depois que dados de emprego abaixo do esperado reduziram as chances de um aumento da taxa de juros no curto prazo, levando os rendimentos dos Treasuries a uma queda, enquanto os preços mais baixos do petróleo contribuíam para o apetite por risco.
item.dc:creator: Johann Cherian, Tharuniyaa Lakshmi
item.content:encoded: As ações dos Estados Unidos subiam nesta sexta-feira, levando o Nasdaq a uma máxima recorde, depois que dados de emprego abaixo do esperado reduziram as chances de um aumento da taxa de juros no curto prazo, levando os rendimentos dos Treasuries a uma queda, enquanto os preços mais baixos do petróleo contribuíam para o apetite por risco. As ações do setor de chips e as megacaps lideravam os ganhos. A Nvidia (NVDA.O) atingiu um pico recorde intradiário com alta de 2,5%, enquanto o índice de chips da Filadélfia (.SOX) registrava alta de 3,1%. Entre outras empresas de grande porte, a SpaceX (SPCX.O) subi 5,5%, a Tesla (TSLA.O) ganhava 4,1% e a Oracle (ORCL.N) tinha alta de 3%. A economia dos EUA abriu 29.000 vagas de trabalho fora do setor agrícola no mês passado, e os números dos dois meses anteriores foram revisados acentuadamente para baixo, mostrou nesta sexta-feira o relatório de emprego do Departamento do Trabalho. Economistas consultados pela Reuters previam criação de 90.000 postos de trabalho. “O número mais baixo de empregos, incluindo a revisão, é, por mais estranho que pareça, uma boa notícia para as ações. Com o mercado de títulos desempenhando organicamente o papel do Federal Reserve recentemente, precisávamos sacrificar um indicador, e o relatório desta manhã atingiu esse objetivo”, disse Todd Schoenberger, diretor de investimentos da CrossCheck Management. Uma série de dados que mostram resiliência na atividade econômica e um aumento dos preços mais lento do que o esperado, juntamente com comentários de pelo menos duas autoridades se opondo a outro aumento nos juros, levaram os investidores a apostar cada vez mais que o banco central deixará os juros inalterados neste mês. Os operadores agora atribuem uma probabilidade de 20% de que o Federal Reserve aumente os juros em 25 pontos-base em outubro, em comparação com 26% antes do relatório. O rendimento do Treasury de dois anos , que está intimamente ligado às expectativas de taxas de juros, recuava pelo segundo dia consecutivo. Contribuindo para o otimismo, os preços do petróleo Brent caíram para menos de US$100 o barril após notícia de que a União Europeia discutiu novas liberações de estoques de diesel e petróleo bruto, embora não houvesse novas atualizações sobre a resolução do conflito no Oriente Médio. O Índice Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) subia 0,60%, para 51.233,34 pontos, enquanto o S&P 500 (.SPX) ganhava 1,02%, a 7.744,76 pontos, e o Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) tinha alta de 1,66%, para 27.319,43 pontos. (Reportagem adicional de Shashwat Chauhan)

item.title: EE.UU. y Australia suspenden servicios consulares en Brasil por seguridad antes de las elecciones
item.description: Las embajadas indicaron que la suspensión responde a motivos de seguridad, sin detallar la naturaleza de las preocupaciones ante los comicios del 4 de octubre.
item.dc:creator: Daniel Carvalho
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Estados Unidos y Australia suspendieron los servicios consulares en Brasil, alegando “motivos de seguridad” ante las elecciones generales que se celebrarán este domingo en el país. La embajada de EE.UU. indicó a los ciudadanos que necesitaran asistencia de emergencia que no acudieran a las instalaciones diplomáticas y que, en su lugar, se pusieran en contacto con un funcionario de guardia por teléfono. La embajada de Australia remitió a los ciudadanos a un centro de emergencias en Canberra. Ninguna de las dos embajadas dio más detalles sobre la naturaleza de las preocupaciones de seguridad. Ver más: Lula y Flávio Bolsonaro ponen a Caixa en el centro de sus planes para aliviar la deuda en Brasil Se ordenó al personal de todas las instalaciones diplomáticas de EE.UU. en Brasil que trabajara desde casa a partir del viernes, según una persona familiarizada con la situación que pidió no ser identificada porque no estaba autorizada a hablar del asunto. El gobierno de EE.UU. afirmó que estaba colaborando con las autoridades brasileñas “para abordar cuestiones de seguridad”. Un portavoz de la embajada no facilitó más detalles cuando fue contactado por Bloomberg News. Ver más: Elecciones en Brasil 2026: qué proponen Lula y Flávio Bolsonaro en economía, seguridad y energía El Ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores de Brasil no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios. En un comunicado independiente publicado únicamente en portugués, un portavoz del Departamento de Estado afirmó que las embajadas y consulados de EE.UU. utilizan habitualmente un sistema de alerta “para informar a los ciudadanos estadounidenses sobre amenazas, acontecimientos y cambios relevantes en las condiciones locales”. Brasil celebra elecciones generales el 4 de octubre en un entorno polarizado, en el que el presidente de izquierdas, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, se encuentra en un reñido empate con su rival conservador, Flávio Bolsonaro. -Con la colaboración de Gabriel Diniz Tavares. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: Torres withdrawn from Spain squad due to injury, Espi called up
item.description: Spain forward Ferran Torres has withdrawn from the national squad with an ankle issue and will be replaced by Carlos Espi for the upcoming Nations League matches, the Spanish Football Federation (RFEF) said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Spain forward Ferran Torres has withdrawn from the national squad with an ankle issue and will be replaced by Carlos Espi for the upcoming Nations League matches, the Spanish Football Federation (RFEF) said on Friday. Torres, who plays for Paris St Germain, has been troubled by minor discomfort in his left ankle and, despite training in recent days, was released from the squad to prioritise his recovery, the RFEF said. Coach Luis de la Fuente called up Espi in his place, rewarding the Real Madrid youngster after he scored five goals and set up two more in Spain Under-21s' 13-0 rout of San Marino on Thursday. "Due to the persistence of the symptoms, the decision was made to withdraw him from the squad to prioritise his recovery," the federation said in a statement, adding its medical staff had remained in constant contact with PSG throughout the camp. Spain host the Czech Republic in Oviedo on Saturday before travelling to face Croatia on October 6.

item.description: [ワシントン ２日 ロイター] - 米商務省が２日発表した８月の製造業新規受注は前月比０．１％増の小幅な伸びにとどまっ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米製造業新規受注、8月は0.1％の小幅増　民間航空機が重し 10/2 23:45 配信

米ワシントン州エベレットにある航空機大手ボーイングの工場。７月撮影。Jennifer Buchanan/Seattle Times

[ワシントン　２日　ロイター] - 米商務省が２日発表した８月の製造業新規受注は前月比０．１％増の小幅な伸びにとどまった。電気機器・家電製品・同部品への強い需要があったものの、低調な民間航空機の受注に相殺された。ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は０．１％増だった。

７月は０．９％増から０．８％増に下方改定された。

８月は前年同月比では６．８％増加した。

人工知能（ＡＩ）インフラの拡充に加え、堅調な国内需要に対応するため企業が在庫を再構築していることが製造業の下支えとなっている。ただ、米国とイスラエルによるイランとの戦争がサプライチェーン（供給網）を混乱させ、エネルギー価格を押し上げている中で、ＡＩ投資ブームと関連性の薄い分野は今後数カ月間、苦戦を強いられる可能性があるとの懸念もある。

８月は、民間航空機・同部品の受注が４．３％減少したことが重しとなった。自動車車体・同部品・トレーラーの受注は０．８％増。機械受注は１．１％増加した。コンピューター・電子製品の受注は横ばいだった一方、前年同月比では１４．７％増加した。電気機器・家電製品・同部品の受注は１．１％急増した。

企業の設備投資計画の指標とされる航空機を除く非国防資本財（コア資本財）の受注は１．６％増と、先月発表の速報値から変わらずだった。コア資本財の出荷は０．５％増と、当初発表の０．６％増から下方改定された。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：米株高支える高い増益、投資家は持続可能性に不安も 焦点：米景気拡大維持、ＦＲＢの利下げペース次第 アングル：出遅れ気味の米不動産株、持ち直し期待高まる 焦点：後退する米企業役員の多様性、トランプ米大統領の政策反映 コラム：「米国例外主義」なお健在、外国投資家のテック株流入持続が示唆 最終更新: 10/2(金) 23:45 ロイター

item.title: El G7 liberará 100 millones de barriles de diésel y otras reservas a través de la AIE
item.description: El grupo de países del G7 llevará a cabo una liberación coordinada de 100 millones de barriles de diésel y otras reservas a través de la Agencia Internacional de la Energía (AIE) para intentar estabilizar los mercados energéticos mundiales, según una declaración conjunta de los líderes del G7 emitida el viernes.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El grupo de países del G7 llevará a cabo una liberación coordinada de 100 millones de barriles de diésel y otras reservas a través de la Agencia Internacional de la Energía (AIE) para intentar estabilizar los mercados energéticos mundiales, según una declaración conjunta de los líderes del G7 emitida el viernes. "Cumpliremos nuestros compromisos con una liberación coordinada, a través de la AIE, de 100 millones de barriles que comenzará de inmediato y se prolongará durante cuatro meses, incluida una liberación sustancial de diésel concentrada en los primeros 20 días por parte de los miembros y socios del G7", dice la declaración, difundida por la oficina del presidente francés, Emmanuel Macron.

item.title: Five French market hot spots on investors' radars
item.description: French markets are under growing pressure from mounting worries about high debt levels and political gridlock as next year's presidential election nears.
item.dc:creator: Amanda Cooper, Harry Robertson, Niket Nishant
item.content:encoded: French markets are under growing pressure from mounting worries about high debt levels and political gridlock as next year's presidential election nears. The French government is seeking €54 billion ($61 billion) in savings in its 2027 budget proposal amid[USN:L1N45O03R TEXT:" protests at schools across the country"] over a lack of resources. Here's a look at five key metrics that have started to flash a warning, potentially further hampering the government's ability to rein in its [USN:L8N4591JN TEXT:"strained finances"]. RISK PREMIUM HITS CRISIS LEVELS The gap between French 10-year borrowing costs and their German equivalents, a measure of the risk premium attached to French debt, has [USN:L6N45C068 TEXT:"risen to its highest"] since the euro zone crisis in 2012, at around 150 basis points . The speed of the move has surprised markets. The French risk premium hasn't blown out this quickly in the space of a week since 2011, when the debt crisis was raging. Ultimately, the European Central Bank has tools to prevent any euro zone member's bond yields from spiralling out of control, although analysts believe [USN:L1N45N0CH TEXT:"there is little chance"] the central bank would need to resort to those for France yet. "Clearly, the market is testing the political situation, telling the politicians: 'you need to be careful with the budget,'" Marion Le Morhedec, CIO of fixed income at Fidelity, told an event on Friday. STOCKS AND BANKS LAG France’s stock market (.FCHI) , down nearly 4% this year, has lagged broader European markets (.STOXX) , which are up roughly 6%. Economic growth is slowing. The Bank of France expects [USN:L1N4570F4 TEXT:"an expansion of just 0.4% this year"], down from 0.9% in 2025. Domestic banks have struggled [USN:L8N4530IU TEXT:"in this low-growth environment"] given concerns about political uncertainty and high government debt. Credit Agricole shares (CAGR.PA) are down 3.8% this year and Societe Generale is down nearly 4% (SOGN.PA) . BNP Paribas (BNPP.PA) shares are up 13.3% in 2026, but are well below the highs of the year. The broader European STOXX banking index (.SX7P) is up 14% in 2026. AT1 bonds, a form of riskier debt issued by French lenders, have come under pressure along with the rest of the market, but less so than France's government debt, suggesting investors are not too concerned yet about the pressure on the banking sector. AT1 bonds act as shock absorbers if a bank's capital levels fall below a certain threshold. They can be converted into equity or written off. CREDIT RISKS MOUNT The cost of insuring French sovereign debt against an increase in default risk has continued to soar, LSEG data shows. With bond yields rising everywhere, credit default swaps have risen for most sovereigns, but the speed at which they have increased for France is far greater than anywhere else. French 5-year CDS trade around 87 basis points, the most since early 2013. That means it costs 87 cents annually to insure every $100 held in French bonds. That's still below the record highs near 200 bps in 2012, but nearly triple what it was just one month ago. In the last three months alone, French CDS have risen 60 bps, compared with 50 bps for Italy and little change for German, US or UK CDS. EURO GLOOM DEEPENS The weaker euro could compound the government's fiscal problems by making imported goods and energy more expensive. The euro has fallen below $1.13 to its weakest level in nearly 18 months, while euro zone bond yields have risen. A falling currency and rising yields typically reflect heightened investor unease. The rise in bond yields has effectively tightened credit conditions enough to prompt traders to assume the ECB will deliver at least two hikes in the coming year, with a roughly 50/50 chance of a third, down from an expectation for at least three hikes last week. Some ECB policymakers have also [USN:L8N4591NP TEXT:"sought to"] [USN:L1N45A0DM TEXT:"temper aggressive market expectations"] for rate hikes. "With growth facing renewed headwinds and French sovereign stress tightening financial conditions independently, we remain sceptical that the ECB can sustain the deposit rate materially above 3%," strategists at Monex said. The ECB deposit rate is currently at 2.5%. CONTAGION RISK One of the principal worries with any major market move is contagion — where investors are forced to sell other assets to cover losses elsewhere — that adds to the down-draught. Italian debt has been performing better than French debt for several years now, as the government in Rome made strides to bring the country's finances into order. But given Italy's large deficit, its bonds and CDS have been pummelled too. Investors now demand an extra 120 bps to lend to Italy for 10 years , rather than Germany, up from just 73 bps at the end of June. UBS analysts said they see the spread hitting 150 bps. Even Belgium, generally regarded as lower risk, has seen its risk premium nearly double in the second half of the year to 90 bps.

item.title: Man City whistleblower to lose witness protection days after club's guilty verdict
item.description: Football Leaks whistleblower Rui Pinto is set to lose his witness protection status in Portugal, his legal team said on Friday, days after an independent commission found Manchester City guilty of serious breaches of the Premier League's financial rules.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Football Leaks whistleblower Rui Pinto is set to lose his witness protection status in Portugal, his legal team said on Friday, days after an independent commission found Manchester City guilty of serious breaches of the Premier League's financial rules. Pinto, whose disclosures helped trigger scrutiny of Manchester City's finances, entered Portugal's witness protection programme in 2020 after agreeing to cooperate with authorities and provide files obtained through the Football Leaks operation. City were [USN:L6N45L10S TEXT:"found guilty"] of all charges relating to breaches of Premier League financial regulations over nine seasons from 2009-10 to 2017-18, as well as three of four charges concerning failures to cooperate with the investigation. The league said this week that City had used "sham" commercial contracts to inflate revenue and understate costs by more than 900 million pounds ($1.19 billion) over nearly a decade, resulting in inaccurate financial reporting and breaches of spending rules. The club have denied wrongdoing and [USN:L1N45O0BQ TEXT:"appealed"] the verdict. "In a few days, without being heard beforehand, as required by law, he would lose the protected, confidential residence assigned to him and be forced to find new housing urgently, with no guarantee that police protection will continue," Pinto's legal team said in a statement posted on his X account. "His situation is now critical. The threats against him are not merely theoretical; he was assaulted in Lisbon last April." FOOTBALL LEAKS Launched in 2015, Football Leaks published millions of confidential documents from the football industry, including transfer agreements, contracts and other deals involving clubs, players and agents. Football Leaks' data seen by Reuters showed how some of the richest and most prominent figures in soccer avoided tax by channelling earnings offshore. Pinto was arrested in Hungary in 2019 before being extradited to Portugal, where he later cooperated with authorities and was placed under witness protection. His lawyers said the programme would end on October 10 and argued the decision leaves him at heightened risk, noting legal proceedings stemming from the leaks remained ongoing, including the recent Manchester City case. "If abruptly deprived of his protected housing and plunged into a state of extreme precariousness, Rui Pinto would be more vulnerable now than at any time since 2020," the statement said. Portugal's Justice Ministry did not immediately respond to a request for comment on Friday.

item.content:encoded:
新会社名は「スカイダンス」、パラマウントのＷＢＤ買収完了後＝ＣＥＯ 10/2 23:40 配信

2025年12月8日撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration

[２日 ロイター] - 米メディア大手パラマウント・スカイダンスのデービッド・エリソン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は２日、ワーナー・ブラザース・ディスカバリー（ＷＢＤ）買収が来週にも完了次第、統合後の新会社名を「スカイダンス」とすると明らかにした。

エリソン氏はソーシャルメディアへの投稿で、パラマウントとワーナー・ブラザースの両映画スタジオの個別のアイデンティティーが失われないようにすることが目的で、新たな企業ブランドの下に統合するものではないと説明した。

その上で、「統合後の会社に独自のアイデンティティーを与えつつ、パラマウントとワーナー・ブラザースをはじめとする優れたブランドが引き続きスポットライトを浴び続けられる名称を望んでいた」と述べた。

item.title: German energy firm SEFE enlists Lazard in reprivatisation efforts
item.description: German state-owned SEFE is working with investment bank Lazard to explore options in Berlin's efforts to sell the energy group, two people familiar with the matter said, as efforts to reshuffle the country's energy landscape pick up.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: German state-owned SEFE is working with investment bank Lazard (LAZ.N) to explore options in Berlin's efforts to sell the energy group, two people familiar with the matter said, as efforts to reshuffle the country's energy landscape pick up. SEFE, short for Securing Energy for Europe, had to be bailed out by Berlin for €6.3 billion ($7.1 billion) in 2022 after former parent Gazprom (GAZP.MM) abandoned the business, which is key for Germany's security of supply. A sales process for SEFE is expected to kick off in 2027 to avoid clashing with Berlin's current efforts to sell a majority stake in peer Uniper (UN0k.DE) , which also had to be rescued in the wake of Europe's energy crisis, the people said. An initial public offering is currently seen as unlikely, one of the sources said. SEFE, which employs more than 2,000 staff, operates a range of activities, including 4,200 kilometres (2,600 miles) of gas pipelines, a quarter of Germany's gas storage capacity and a large commodity trading desk. The company, which has already paid back close to €1 billion in state aid, supplies more than 200 terawatt hours of gas and power to more than 50,000 industrial customers, including municipalities and companies. SEFE, which made core profit of €789 million on sales of €15.5 billion last year, said in April it had proposed a capital increase of up to €2 billion to Germany's Economy Ministry, which oversees ownership of the company. SEFE and Lazard declined to comment. Under European Union state aid rules, Germany must cut its ownership in both SEFE and Uniper to no more than 25% plus one share by the end of 2028. Boersen-Zeitung first reported the appointment of Lazard. ($1 = €0.8890)

item.title: G7 to release 100 million barrels of diesel and other reserves through IEA
item.description: The G7 group of nations will undertake a co-ordinated release of 100 million barrels of diesel and other reserves through the International Energy Agency (IEA) to try and stabilise world energy markets, according to a joint G7 leaders' statement on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The G7 group of nations will undertake a co-ordinated release of 100 million barrels of diesel and other reserves through the International Energy Agency (IEA) to try and stabilise world energy markets, according to a joint G7 leaders' statement on Friday. "We will implement our commitments with a coordinated release through the IEA of 100 million barrels to begin immediately over 4 months, including a frontloaded substantial diesel release within the first 20 days by G7 members and partners," said the statement, released by the office of French President Emmanuel Macron.

item.title: GRÁFICO Ahora le toca a Brasil, en un año electoral de gran repercusión y con EEUU en la mira
item.description: Los votantes brasileños elegirán este domingo entre un grupo de candidatos presidenciales en el que destacan dos figuras conocidas: el presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva y su rival de la derecha Flávio Bolsonaro, en unas elecciones que están siendo muy seguidas por los inversores.
item.dc:creator: Libby George, Dhara Ranasinghe
item.content:encoded: Los votantes brasileños elegirán este domingo entre un grupo de candidatos presidenciales en el que destacan dos figuras conocidas: el presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva y su rival de la derecha Flávio Bolsonaro, en unas elecciones que están siendo muy seguidas por los inversores. La contienda es una de las varias elecciones pendientes, de las cerca de 40 que se celebran este año en todo el mundo, que podrían afectar a los mercados financieros. A continuación, ofrecemos un resumen de las próximas elecciones que centran la atención de los mercados financieros, así como un resumen de las que ya se han celebrado: BRASIL Las encuestas muestran que el actual presidente Lula y Flávio Bolsonaro, hijo del expresidente Jair Bolsonaro, están muy igualados, por lo que es probable que haya una segunda vuelta el 25 de octubre. Flávio ha tratado de sacar partido de la preocupación por el costo de la vida. Los inversionistas se muestran en general optimistas respecto a Brasil, pero las preocupaciones fiscales, agravadas por el aumento del gasto, son el principal motivo de inquietud. "Los fundamentos fiscales son el riesgo más preocupante de una posible reelección de Lula, y los diferenciales actuales (de los bonos) no reflejan ese riesgo", dijo Christine Reed, gestora de carteras de Ninety One. No obstante, solo una pequeña parte del gasto de Brasil es discrecional, lo que significa que los ajustes duraderos tendrían que afectar a las pensiones, las nóminas o las prestaciones sociales. Capital Economics señaló que una victoria de Flávio podría impulsar las acciones entre un 10% y un 20% y hacer bajar los rendimientos de los bonos en moneda local, mientras que una victoria de Lula podría provocar un rendimiento inferior de la renta variable. ISRAEL Los votantes israelíes elegirán a los miembros del Parlamento del país, el Knesset, de 120 escaños, en las elecciones del 27 de octubre. Las encuestas apuntan a una derrota del primer ministro Benjamin Netanyahu, pero ningún partido ha obtenido jamás la mayoría absoluta, y los Gobiernos suelen formarse mediante coaliciones. La economía israelí ha demostrado una notable resistencia al conflicto de Oriente Medio. Sin embargo, Moody’s ha bajado sus estimaciones de crecimiento económico para 2026 y ha elevado sus previsiones de deuda, debido a los altos riesgos geopolíticos y a la fragilidad de los acuerdos de alto el fuego. El presidente del banco central del país advirtió de que los ganadores de las elecciones deben frenar el gasto público destinado a defensa e invertir más en educación, infraestructuras y otros motores de crecimiento. EEUU Las elecciones legislativas de Estados Unidos del 3 de noviembre se celebran en un contexto de precios récord del diésel y de un aumento de los costos de financiación del Estado que ha impulsado al alza las tasas hipotecarias . Los votantes decidirán si los republicanos conservan el control de ambas cámaras del Congreso o si los demócratas obtienen el poder para marcar el rumbo de los dos últimos años del mandato del presidente Donald Trump. Si bien algunos analistas advierten de que un Congreso dividido podría ser negativo para el dólar estadounidense, los resultados de las elecciones podrían repercutir en todo, desde la guerra con Irán hasta los precios de la energía, pasando por las erráticas medidas arancelarias de Trump. NUEVA ZELANDA La reputación de estabilidad política de Nueva Zelanda se pondrá a prueba en las reñidas elecciones del 7 de noviembre, y las encuestas de opinión sugieren que la coalición del primer ministro Christopher Luxon podría perder el poder. Un mandato redefinido para el banco central de Nueva Zelanda y los cambios de rumbo en las políticas son algunas de las perspectivas que inquietan a los inversionistas.

item.title: Israele, leader arabo si ritira da elezioni dopo pressioni Corte
item.description: Di seguito gli aggiornamenti sulla situazione in Medio Oriente:
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Di seguito gli aggiornamenti sulla situazione in Medio Oriente: 16.00 - Il leader di un partito arabo di sinistra si è ritirato dalle elezioni in Israele dopo che la Corte Suprema del Paese lo ha informato che la maggioranza dei giudici era favorevole alla sua squalifica qualora non si fosse ritirato volontariamente. È la prima volta che la Corte Suprema apre alla possibilità di accogliere una richiesta della Commissione elettorale centrale di squalificare un politico arabo-israeliano. L'organizzazione per i diritti umani Adalah ha detto che la decisione della Corte stabilisce standard diversi di partecipazione politica per i cittadini ebrei e per quelli arabi. La Commissione elettorale centrale israeliana, un organo politico, aveva chiesto la squalifica di Sami Abu Shehadeh, leader del partito Balad, per un articolo in cui definiva l'attacco di Hamas contro Israele del 7 ottobre 2023 "un importante evento storico". I partiti di estrema destra lo hanno accusato di sostenere l'attacco, accusa che lui respinge.

item.title: US issues sanctions against Hamas financing network, Treasury says
item.description: The United States issued additional sanctions on Friday targeting Hamas' financial network, including targeting a member of the Palestinian militant group's military wing, two France-based fundraisers and two entities, the Treasury Department said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The United States issued additional sanctions on Friday targeting Hamas' financial network, including targeting a member of the Palestinian militant group's military wing, two France-based fundraisers and two entities, the Treasury Department said. "These designations expose a sophisticated, multi‑year financing architecture that moved more than $2 million to Hamas through deceptive charitable fronts and cryptocurrency channels, demonstrating the organization’s persistent ability to adapt its fundraising mechanisms to evade detection," Treasury said in a statement. The Hamas member, Saleem Abdallah Saleem al-Zaq, is a battalion deputy in the Hamas military wing based in Gaza, Treasury said. He oversees a financial network that has used various money services businesses and cryptocurrency wallets to transfer significant funds to the Hamas Al-Qassam Brigades, it added.

item.title: Encomendas à indústria dos EUA têm leve alta em agosto
item.description: As novas encomendas à indústria dos Estados Unidos registraram leve alta em agosto uma vez que a demanda forte por equipamentos elétricos, eletrodomésticos e componentes foi compensada pela queda nas encomendas de aeronaves comerciais.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: As novas encomendas à indústria dos Estados Unidos registraram leve alta em agosto uma vez que a demanda forte por equipamentos elétricos, eletrodomésticos e componentes foi compensada pela queda nas encomendas de aeronaves comerciais. As encomendas à indústria subiram 0,1% após um salto de 0,8% em julho em dado revisado para baixo, informou nesta sexta-feira o Census Bureau do Departamento de Comércio. Economistas consultados pela Reuters previam alta de 0,1% nas encomendas, após aumento de 0,9% em julho divulgado anteriormente. As encomendas aumentaram 6,8% em agosto em relação ao mesmo mês do ano anterior. A expansão da infraestrutura de IA está sustentando o setor manufatureiro, assim como as empresas que estão reabastecendo seus estoques para atender à demanda doméstica. Há, no entanto, preocupações de que segmentos não relacionados ao boom de gastos com IA possam enfrentar dificuldades nos próximos meses em meio aos obstáculos decorrentes da guerra entre os EUA e Israel contra o Irã, que atrapalhou as cadeias de oferta e elevou os preços da energia. Os pedidos às fábricas em agosto foram prejudicados por uma queda de 4,3% nas encomendas de aeronaves civis e peças. Os pedidos de carrocerias, peças e reboques de veículos motorizados aumentaram 0,8%. Os pedidos de maquinário dispararam 1,1%. Os pedidos de computadores e produtos eletrônicos permaneceram inalterados, mas registraram alta de 14,7% em relação ao mesmo período do ano anterior. Os pedidos de equipamentos elétricos, eletrodomésticos e componentes subiram 1,1%. (Reportagem de Lucia Mutikani)

item.title: ANP delimita novos setores para exploração petrolífera na Margem Equatorial
item.description: A diretoria da Agência Nacional do Petróleo, Gás Natural e Biocombustíveis (ANP) aprovou nesta sexta-feira a delimitação de 11 novos setores exploratórios na Margem Equatorial Brasileira, em área incorporada à Plataforma Continental Brasileira, ampliando os limites para a indústria de petróleo.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A diretoria da Agência Nacional do Petróleo, Gás Natural e Biocombustíveis (ANP) aprovou nesta sexta-feira a delimitação de 11 novos setores exploratórios na Margem Equatorial Brasileira, em área incorporada à Plataforma Continental Brasileira, ampliando os limites para a indústria de petróleo. A aprovação foi decidida no mesmo dia em que a Petrobras anunciou [USN:S0N44S06Y TEXT:"nova descoberta"] de petróleo na Bacia da Foz do Amazonas, que integra a Margem Equatorial, região vista pela indústria com potencial de se tornar uma nova fronteira na produção do país. A medida da ANP configura 501 novos blocos exploratórios, disse a agência, ressaltando que a decisão atualiza a organização territorial da região após a ampliação do limite exterior da Plataforma Continental Brasileira, conforme decisão da Organização das Nações Unidas (ONU) de março de 2025. A aprovação dos setores, no entanto, não significa que os 501 blocos serão incluídos automaticamente no sistema de Oferta Permanente da ANP. "Uma eventual indicação de blocos para oferta dependerá de análise específica e deverá seguir o rito regulatório aplicável...", afirmou a ANP. Os 11 novos setores estão distribuídos nas bacias de Barreirinhas, Ceará, Foz do Amazonas, Potiguar e Pará-Maranhão e abrangem aproximadamente 380 mil km², em áreas de lâmina d'água superior a 3 mil metros. A atualização não afeta contratos vigentes, pois as novas áreas ainda não estão contratadas, acrescentou a agência em nota. Segundo a ANP, também foram ajustados os limites de três setores já existentes -- SFZA-AP4, SPAMA-AUP1 e SPAMA-AUP2 -- em função da nova configuração da Plataforma Continental.

item.title: Rebel-held eastern Congo records six new Ebola cases
item.description: Six new Ebola cases have been recorded in areas of eastern Congo controlled by AFC/M23 rebels, the group said, days after the only previously known active case in rebel-held territory was discharged.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Six new Ebola cases have been recorded in areas of eastern Congo controlled by AFC/M23 rebels, the group said, days after the only previously known active case in rebel-held territory was discharged. The Rwanda-backed AFC/M23 rebels control large parts of North and South Kivu provinces after staging a lightning offensive last year The rebels declared areas under their control Ebola-free in late June, having previously recorded only four cases, but a new case was confirmed in Kayna health zone in North Kivu in early September. That patient was discharged on Tuesday after spending 26 days at the Ebola treatment centre there Two new cases were detected in Kayna health zone and four in neighbouring Alimbongo health zone on Friday, the rebels said in a statement The two health zones are near Lubero, close to the front line with government forces Epidemiological investigations showed the six cases were part of the same chain of transmission stemming from a case that came from the city of Butembo in government-held territory, according to the statement Four of the cases were identified through post-mortem testing of people who died in the community, while the other two patients are receiving treatment, the rebels said Efforts are underway to identify and trace contacts, the statement added The Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo was declared on May 15 and has now caused [USN:L1N45O094 TEXT:"more than 4,000 deaths"] among 8,300 confirmed cases, according to government data released on Friday

item.title: Dangote's planned Kenya refinery faces legal challenge by consumer-rights group
item.description: Nigerian billionaire Aliko Dangote's $16 billion oil refinery in Kenya faces another legal challenge, this time from a consumer-rights group alleging that key details about the project have not been made public.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Nigerian billionaire Aliko Dangote's [USN:L1N45M098 TEXT:"$16 billion oil refinery"] in Kenya faces another legal challenge, this time from a consumer-rights group alleging that key details about the project have not been made public. The Consumers Federation of Kenya (COFEK) filed a petition with the Public Private Partnerships Petition Committee, COFEK Secretary General Stephen Mutoro said in a post on X. It is the second legal hurdle for the 700,000-barrel-per-day (bpd) refinery, after more than 130 residents filed a [USN:L8N45L0SZ TEXT:"lawsuit"], saying the land in Lamu — where the plant is being built — is their ancestral heritage. A hearing on the case is due on October 14. COFEK wants any non-compliant approvals set aside for the refinery and reconsidered. It wants details about the government's plan to take a stake in the refinery to be disclosed, such as the acquisition vehicle, share class and payment terms and evidence that there was public participation, among other things. A Dangote Group spokesperson declined to comment. A Kenyan government spokesperson did not immediately respond to a request for comment. When he broke ground to start construction on Wednesday, Dangote shrugged off the land rights claim and expressed confidence the refinery would go ahead, saying: "Anybody who wants to cause trouble, we are ready." Dangote is looking to replicate his group's 700,000 bpd refinery in Nigeria. He has offered regional governments a combined 30% stake in the Lamu refinery, which is scheduled to be completed in 2030.

item.title: 欧州がディーゼル備蓄放出で合意、トランプ氏 価格抑制へ米が圧力
item.description: [ワシントン ２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン　２日　ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２日、イラン戦争を背景とした燃料価格の高騰を抑制するよう求める米国の圧力を受け、欧州がディーゼル（軽油）燃料の備蓄を放出することで合意したと明らかにした。

トランプ大統領は「欧州は大量に備蓄しているディーゼルを大規模に放出することに合意した。手続きは直ちに開始される」と自身の交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」に投稿した。

関係筋の１人がロイターに語ったところによると、米国はフランスやドイツを含む欧州の主要国に対し、２０日以内に１億バレルのディーゼルを放出するよう要求した。

フランスのエリゼ宮（大統領府）によると、マクロン仏大統領は１日夜、トランプ大統領と電話会談を行い、燃料価格の高騰に対処し、精製石油製品の世界的な供給を確保するために協力する必要性を強調した。こうした中、ＥＵ加盟国は２日、欧州諸国が５０００万バレルのディーゼルを、国際エネルギー機関（ＩＥＡ）加盟国が５０００万バレルの原油を放出するという仏の提案について協議したと関係筋は話している。

マクロン仏大統領はその後、主要７カ国（Ｇ７）首脳とのビデオ会議を開催し、エネルギー情勢について協議した。

item.title: Israeli officials to question co-pilot of flydubai flight, source says
item.description: Israeli officials are expected to question the co-pilot who allegedly attempted to crash a commercial passenger flight from Dubai bound for Tel Aviv, according to a source briefed on the investigation.
item.dc:creator: Alexander Cornwell
item.content:encoded: Israeli officials are expected to question the co-pilot who allegedly attempted to crash a commercial [USN:L6N45N0GW TEXT:"passenger flight"] from Dubai bound for Tel Aviv, according to a source briefed on the investigation. Disaster was averted on [USN:L4N45N0NH TEXT:"flydubai"] flight FZ1073 on Wednesday after passengers and crew subdued the co-pilot, who had [USN:L1N45M07P TEXT:"stabbed"] the captain in what Israeli officials have said was an apparent attempt to crash the plane carrying over 170 passengers and crew. A reserve flydubai pilot crew travelling on the flight landed the plane at Tabuk airport in northwestern Saudi Arabia, where the co-pilot was detained by Saudi Arabian authorities. The co-pilot was transferred on Thursday to the UAE, where the source said Israeli officials were expected to question him. The source declined to say which Israeli agency or authority would take part in the questioning. Asked whether Israeli officials would question the co-pilot, an Israeli government official told Reuters that Israeli investigators would take part in the UAE-led investigation alongside Emirati authorities, seeking to determine what happened and examine the suspect's motives and background. The UAE foreign ministry did not immediately respond to a request for comment on whether Israeli officials would question the co-pilot. In his first public comments on the incident, flydubai Chief Executive Ghaith Al Ghaith said on Friday that authorities were conducting an official investigation, supported by the airline, after what he described as a "safety incident" in the cockpit. "It is important that we allow this process to establish the facts," he said in a written statement, acknowledging that there were "many questions" about what happened on flight FZ1073. The UAE state news agency reported on Thursday that Emirati authorities had opened an investigation seeking to establish the circumstances and motives and determine "whether the incident was linked to any terrorist activity or purpose, or involved prior planning or direction". MOTIVE NOT YET ESTABLISHED Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said on Friday that Israel was looking into whether the co-pilot had acted under anyone's direction, warning in a video statement released by his office that whoever was involved would pay a "heavy price". Most of the passengers on board were Israeli nationals. Netanyahu on Thursday said that the co-pilot, whom he has identified as an Omani national, had undergone radical Islamist indoctrination and was clearly suicidal, but that so far a motive for his actions had not been established. Israel does not have official diplomatic relations with Oman, and Netanyahu has said pilots from such countries were not permitted to operate flights to Israel. It was not clear how the co-pilot came to be assigned to the flight to Tel Aviv. The aircraft plunged some 16,625 feet in just over 30 seconds as it flew over Saudi Arabia on the journey from the United Arab Emirates to Israel, according to data from flight tracker Flightradar24. The route is popular among Israelis. CAPTAIN HAILED AS HERO The co-pilot's identity has not been publicly disclosed beyond his nationality. The captain who was stabbed has been identified as Indian national [USN:L4N45M1MF TEXT:"Smit Machchhar"], who has been [USN:L1N45N01H TEXT:"hailed"] as a hero by Netanyahu and Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Omani authorities have not commented on the incident. The incident heightened security fears in Israel weeks before Israelis vote on October 27, in the first general election since the Hamas-led attacks on October 7, 2023, with Israel's security featuring prominently in the campaigning. The US and Israel launched strikes against Iran in February, in a war that quickly spread to the Gulf and Lebanon, where Israel has been fighting Iran-backed militant group Hezbollah. Since coming under attack by Iran this year, the UAE has strengthened its relationships with Israel, with which it opened ties as a result of the 2020 Abraham Accords.

item.title: Mexico to propose bill to curb violent social media content after school attack
item.description: Mexico's government expects to issue a bill next week requiring social media platforms to remove content that incites violence, president Claudia Sheinbaum said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Mexico's government expects to issue a bill next week requiring social media platforms to remove content that incites violence, president Claudia Sheinbaum said on Friday. The announcement comes after Thursday's [USN:L6N45N12T TEXT:"deadly attack at a school"] in Mexico's northern Coahuila state, which left a vice principal dead and four people injured. Two 18-year-olds believed to be the attackers were arrested at the scene. "The goal is for digital platforms to take on some of the responsibility and refrain from disseminating, promoting, or spreading content related to this type of information—including criminal acts or violent behavior," Sheinbaum said during her daily press conference. She stated that the government will seek a bill, law, or other legal framework that would require all social media platforms to comply. Proposed as a measure to protect Mexico's young people from exposure to violence, Sheinbaum also said that authorities are open to dialogue with the platforms. Countries including Australia and the United Kingdom, as well as the European Union have passed laws requiring social media platforms to remove violent content. In Latin America, [USN:S0N3S10A3 TEXT:"Brazil has gone the furthest"]: its Supreme Court ruled in 2025 that platforms must remove content that incites violence. Lawmakers in Argentina, Chile and Costa Rica are considering bills that would restrict children's access to social media and require platforms to block harmful content, including sexual or violent material aimed at minors.

クレイトン米国家情報長官。7月15日、ワシントンで撮影。REUTERS/Nathan Howard

[ワシントン ２日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領が、クレイトン国家情報長官を人工知能（ＡＩ）担当責任者「ＡＩツァー（czar）」に指名する見通しであることが分かった。ＣＮＮが２日、関係筋の話として報じた。

item.title: テスラの世界納車、第3四半期は市場予想上回る 欧州で需要回復
item.description:
Anhata Rooprai Akash Sriram
[２日 ロイター] - 米電気自動車（ＥＶ）大手テスラが２日発...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
テスラの世界納車、第3四半期は市場予想上回る　欧州で需要回復 10/2 23:16 配信

フランス・パリ近郊にあるテスラの納車センター。2025年4月撮影。REUTERS/Benoit Tessier

Anhata Rooprai　Akash Sriram

[２日　ロイター] - 米電気自動車（ＥＶ）大手テスラが２日発表した第３・四半期（７─９月期）の世界納車台数は４８万６５３２台と、市場予想を上回った。欧州での需要回復が、米国での税制優遇措置の失効や中国での競争激化による影響を相殺した。

同社の株価は午前の取引で約４％超上昇した。

ビジブル・アルファがまとめたアナリスト予想平均は４５万６８９６台だった。今年初めとは異なり、アナリストらは納車台数の通年予想を引き上げている。２０２６年の納車台数は１８２万台と、６月時点のコンセンサス予想の１６５万台から上方修正した。

ただ、納車台数が３年連続で前年比減となる事態を回避するには、同社は第４・四半期に少なくとも３１万１４４８台を納車する必要がある。

欧州では昨年、イーロン・マスク最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）の政治的言動への反発などから販売が低迷したものの、欧州連合（ＥＵ）での新車登録台数は８月までで約３分の２増加。フランスでは「モデルＹ」が全車種を通じて最も売れた車となった。

モーニングスターのアナリスト、セス・ゴールドスタイン氏は「この堅調な数字により、テスラは２年連続の減少を経て、通年の納車台数が増加に転じる軌道に乗った。ＦＳＤ（完全自動運転）が、消費者が他の自動車メーカーではなくテスラを選ぶ決め手となっている」と述べた。

テスラの第３・四半期の車両生産台数は４６万４３９１台で、予想の４８万６７６１台を下回った。

item.title: Espagne Camouflet pour Sanchez, les décrets sur le logement rejetés par les députés
item.description: Le gouvernement espagnol a essuyé vendredi un revers majeur avec le rejet au Congrès des députés de mesures destinées à lutter contre la crise du logement, crise à l'origine de manifestations dans tout le pays qui ont pris de l'ampleur après l'expulsion en septembre d'une locataire de 87 ans à Madrid.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Le gouvernement espagnol a essuyé vendredi un revers majeur avec le rejet au Congrès des députés de mesures destinées à lutter contre la crise du logement, crise à l'origine de manifestations dans tout le pays qui ont pris de l'ampleur après l'expulsion en septembre d'une locataire de 87 ans à Madrid. Le principal des deux décrets-lois a été rejeté par 178 voix à la Chambre basse du Parlement, qui compte 350 sièges, après que Junts, parti séparatiste catalan de droite et allié théorique du gouvernement, a déclaré que ces mesures finiraient par restreindre le marché du logement. Ces [USN:L6N45L0P2 TEXT:"propositions"] comprenaient l’interdiction des expulsions de locataires vulnérables jusqu’en 2030, la prolongation de deux ans du gel des loyers pour les baux existants et un durcissement des règles relatives aux locations de courte durée. Le gouvernement de coalition de gauche minoritaire du président du gouvernement espagnol Pedro Sánchez ne dispose que de 147 sièges sur 350 et doit s'appuyer sur de petits partis, dont Junts et ses sept députés, pour faire adopter ses lois. Les partis d’opposition se sont également opposés à ce décret. Le deuxième décret, qui prévoyait le renouvellement automatique et indéfini des baux et constituait l’une des principales revendications des manifestants, n'a pas non plus été approuvé. DES APPELS À LA "GRÈVE GÉNÉRALE" Le Syndicat des locataires, qui avait été à l’origine des manifestations, a déclaré qu’il poursuivrait ses projets d’organiser de nouveaux rassemblements de masse samedi, afin d’accentuer la pression sur la coalition. "Le campement va se maintenir et continuera de s’étendre à d’autres quartiers. Notre objectif est d’organiser une grève générale", a déclaré Alicia del Rio, porte-parole du Syndicat des locataires. Une foule s’est rassemblée devant le Parlement en scandant "vos profits, notre misère" au moment du vote. Avant le scrutin, la porte-parole parlementaire de Junts, Miriam Nogueras, avait déclaré que ces décrets auraient l’effet inverse de celui escompté. "Trouver un logement deviendra chaque jour plus difficile. Notre responsabilité est d’apporter de la certitude, pas de l’incertitude." Elle a exhorté le gouvernement à élaborer de nouvelles mesures. L’expulsion de la retraitée Maricarmen Abascal a déclenché des manifestations dans toute l’Espagne. Des centaines de jeunes ont installé des tentes sur la place centrale de Madrid et dans d’autres villes pendant près d’une semaine, ravivant le souvenir des sit-in anti-austérité déclenchés par la crise financière mondiale de 2008-2012. Les loyers ont doublé au cours de la dernière décennie, les tarifs moyens atteignant 1.176€ par mois, soit 98,7% du salaire moyen d’un jeune, selon le Conseil de la jeunesse d’Espagne. "Les gens ont dit 'ça suffit' ; cela ne peut pas continuer ainsi. Le problème du logement doit être résolu ; des mesures structurelles doivent être prises, et cette situation ne peut perdurer", a déclaré jeudi l’avocate d’Abascal, Beatriz Duro, lors d’un entretien avec Reuters.
